_about: TrackPoli WCAG 2.2 A/AA conformance record. It now covers two concurrent surfaces merged together: (1) TP1-06 role-based access — the authenticated app shell (the role-gated side navigation and the top bar), the forbidden (403) and not-found (404) screens, and the guarded placeholder routes; and (2) the shadcn/ui migration (ADR-0011), where PR 3 migrates the sign-in, sign-in/verify (MFA) and account-locked screens, PR 4 the password-reset flow (ForgotPasswordPage, ResetPasswordPage), and PR 5 the MFA-enrol wizard (MfaEnrolPage — its 7 raw buttons become shadcn ghost buttons keeping their MD3 module styling, proven by MfaEnrolPage.test.tsx), and PR 6 the Security-tab two-factor card and device-replacement modal (TwoFactorCard — its ~9 raw buttons become shadcn ghost buttons keeping their MD3 module styling; label association, aria-invalid and role=alert preserved, proven by TwoFactorCard.test.tsx), from the hand-built Button/TextField/Banner to the shadcn/ui button/input/label/alert primitives themed from the SAME MD3 grayscale tokens, with Tailwind Preflight on. For the shadcn surfaces the a11y CONTRACT is preserved and PROVEN by the component unit tests (RTL + Vitest): programmatic label association (Label htmlFor + Input id), aria-invalid on the error state, aria-describedby for helper text, role=alert on the error banner (shadcn Alert), the password visibility toggle (aria-label + aria-pressed), and native-button keyboard operability. LIMITATION (evidence state: not-assessed): the RENDERED visual appearance and colour CONTRAST of the shadcn primitives, and any Preflight-on regression across the not-yet-migrated screens, were NOT verified headlessly (no visual-diff; the sign-in e2e needs Supabase/Turnstile env) — a human/Figma pass is required before merge. All of this builds on the TP1-02 sign-in, TP1-03 recovery, TP1-04 two-factor and TP1-05 safe-session surfaces. pass-manual verdicts are agent static reviews of the markup, CSS and ARIA; a full human keyboard + screen-reader audit of the real screens is scheduled for P1-16 (NFR-A1), and a live check of the authenticated shell is pending the full-stack stack (it cannot render without a session). Colour is deliberately grayscale for now (ADR-0006), so contrast criteria are re-verified when the brand colour lands. TP1-07 (P1-12, ADR-0013) adds the responsive admin workspace shell and the shared component library (AppShell with a skip link and a focus-trapping nav drawer, NavItem, PageHeader, FormField/PasswordField/OtpField, ConfirmDialog, Snackbar, StatusTag, Empty/Loading/ErrorState, ErrorBoundary) on shadcn/ui, and migrates the TP1-06 shell onto the design system (retiring its waivers). Unlike the earlier surfaces, the shell and components ARE verified headlessly here: an axe scan of the component gallery and the shell demo reports 0 serious/critical violations (E2E-14), and a keyboard pass covers the skip link, the nav drawer's focus trap/return, and the 320px reflow (E2E-13). ADR-0018: the component gallery's breadcrumb demo href was corrected to a basePath-relative value (no literal /admin, which would 404-double-prefix); this is a link-TARGET change only - no a11y semantics (the link role, its accessible name, focus order, or ARIA) changed, and the gallery remains the E2E-14 axe target (0 serious/critical). TP1-08 (P1-17, ADR-0019) adds the terms & privacy acceptance screen (src/app/terms, src/features/terms) on shadcn/ui: two new primitives (Tabs and Checkbox on Radix, so role=tablist/tab/tabpanel and role=checkbox with aria-checked, roving focus and Space/arrow operation come from Radix), each document rendered in a labelled, keyboard-focusable scroll region (role=region + aria-label + tabindex=0), an explicit affirmative acceptance (the checkbox gates the Accept button), and the error banner as the role=alert Alert. The a11y contract is PROVEN by the component unit tests (tabs.test, checkbox.test) and the screen unit tests (TermsAcceptance.test: the labelled region, the checkbox gating, tab switching); a full axe scan and human keyboard + screen-reader pass of the rendered screen are pending the full-stack session (it cannot render without a session) and the P1-16 audit. TP1-09 (P1-08, ADR-0020) adds the accept-invite screen (src/app/accept-invite, src/features/auth/AcceptInvitePage) on shadcn/ui, adapted from the sign-in frame (Figma 1216-2431): it composes the SAME primitives already covered above (Label htmlFor + Input id association, the read-only invited Email, two new-password fields with the aria-pressed show/hide toggle, aria-invalid + aria-describedby on the mismatch helper, the role=alert Alert error banner, the native-button Continue-with-Google and Activate actions), so its a11y contract is preserved and PROVEN by the screen unit tests (AcceptInvitePage.test.tsx: labelled read-only email, the password-rule gating, the mismatch helper, the visibility toggle) — and, unusually for an authenticated screen, it was additionally rendered headlessly for TP1-09 and inspected with no console errors (the brand lockup, both password fields, the 12-character rule, the Google and Activate buttons and the audit footnote render as designed). The extended /auth/confirm Continue page (ConfirmPage) gains an invite branch (copy + destination) with no change to its roles, focus order or ARIA. A full axe scan and human keyboard + screen-reader pass of the authenticated accept-invite flow remain pending the full-stack session and the P1-16 audit. TP1-10 (admin management, P1-13) adds the manager-only Admin-management list and its action dialogs on the shadcn primitives. The list is a semantic table (scope=col headers for Name/Role/Status/Last sign-in/Added; the design Two-factor column is intentionally dropped as redundant with Status), with a search Input carrying an aria-label, a status filter rendered as a group of aria-pressed toggle Buttons, a polite live-region result count, and the loading/error/empty states from ui/states (each a labelled region). Two new ui/ primitives (DropdownMenu and Select, both Radix) supply the row more-actions menu and the role picker, so the menu/listbox roles, roving-tabindex keyboard navigation, type-ahead, and focus-trap-and-return come from Radix. The seven dialogs (invite, change-role, change-email, recreate, deactivate, reactivate, last-manager-blocked) compose the Dialog and FormField primitives: focus is trapped and returned to the trigger, each dialog is labelled by its title and described by its body, field errors link via aria-describedby + aria-invalid and form-level errors are a role=alert line, and the destructive recreate requires typing the email to confirm. The a11y contract is PROVEN by the dialog unit tests (adminDialogs.test.tsx) and the primitives pass the combined-checklist gate. A full axe scan and human keyboard + screen-reader pass of the authenticated list and dialogs remain pending the full-stack session and the P1-16 audit. Regenerate per surface as more screens land.

4.1.2.note: Native elements provide name/role/value; the replacement modal exposes role=dialog + aria-modal + aria-labelledby; the Google re-auth button exposes its state; code fields expose aria-invalid/aria-describedby. TP1-05: the warning dialog exposes role=alertdialog + aria-modal + aria-labelledby/aria-describedby; all actions are buttons with text names. TP1-06: the active nav item sets aria-current='page', section toggles set aria-expanded, the collapse toggle sets aria-pressed with an aria-label, and the breadcrumb nav is labelled; names/roles/values are programmatically determinable. PR 3/4 (shadcn): the migrated sign-in/verify/locked/password-reset screens keep native name/role/value — shadcn Button renders a native <button>, Input exposes aria-invalid + aria-describedby, Label associates via htmlFor/id. Label association and role=alert are asserted at the screen level (SignInPage/MfaVerifyPage unit tests: getByLabelText, getByRole('alert')); aria-invalid is asserted by the isolated primitive test (component-accessibility.test.tsx, A2); aria-describedby is verified by code read only. PR 7 (shadcn, final migration): the session-timeout warning dialog is migrated to the shadcn Button; both actions (Stay signed in/Sign out, Sign in again/Dismiss) stay native <button>s with text accessible names, verified by SessionWarningDialog.test.tsx. Shell migration (TP1-06 -> shadcn): the side-nav collapse toggle (aria-pressed), the section headers (aria-expanded) and Log out, plus the error-state action, are migrated from raw <button> to the shadcn Button - still native <button>s keeping their accessible names and aria state (asserted by SideNav.test.tsx / ErrorState.test.tsx). Rendered visual/contrast parity of these shell controls is NOT assessed here and still owes a human/axe + Figma pass.
